objects.name: Analytic 2165
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies ip link set down commands on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux gateway hosts by a User Identifier (UID) not in the authorized net admin UIDs, affecting the device subnet interface. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
